[[The Jade Quarry (Kurzick)]] | henchman = y | merchant = y | storage = y }} {{Quotation|game|Although [[the Jade Sea]] more than lives up to its name, the [[Jadeite Shard|jade]] that makes up its petrified waves is not necessarily of the best quality. [[The Jade Quarry]] has been literally carved from the stretch of seabed that contains the finest and most valuable jade derived from the mineralized bodies of countless sea creatures. Mining in the Jade Quarry is extremely dangerous, as the [[Kurzick]]s and [[Luxon]]s are almost constantly fighting over this valuable resource.}} The [[Jade Flats (Kurzick)|Jade Flats]] is the outpost that separates [[the Jade Quarry (Kurzick)|the Jade Quarry]] from the [[Echovald Forest]]. == Getting there == Start from [[Lutgardis Conservatory]] and head northeast (you could start from [[Brauer Academy]], but the route is longer).
